geometry_edits: Rebuilt House_301840872 from the exact 14-vertex GIS footprint in campus coordinates.
Replaced the generic 16 m massing with two visible facade levels, red brick wings, and a raised central entry bay aligned to the footprint’s east-side jogs.
Added a stone-arched center entry, upper arched window, stylized Delta Gamma letters, grouped wing windows, and broad entry steps based on the exterior photo.
Used a low hidden roof cap because the image crops the roof; exact form and heights remain unknown.
uncertainties: Official GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 conflicts with two facade levels visible in the photo; meaning of NUM_LEVELS is undocumented.
No measured height or complete roof image exists in available sources.
Member photograph is not georeferenced; selected east-facing frontage is illustrative, not verified.
Window patterns, floor heights, central bay dimensions, and stair sizes are schematic estimates.
